append_section:
**fleet (shared tooling, consumed, never copied)**
- `.fleet/version` holds the fleet release this repository uses (`v1.x.y`, the same tag the workflow pins carry). `tools/fleet sync --to v1.x.y` writes, and `tools/fleet drift` checks: `tools/fleet` (the CLI shim), `.claude/skills/fleet-fix-with-checks/`, `fleet-design-signoff/`, `fleet-agent-task/`, `fleet-review-guidance/`, `.claude/agents/fleet-reviewer.md`, `.claude/hooks/fleet-session-start.sh`, and the `AGENTS.md` blocks. None of them is edited here; a change goes to fleet.
- `.claude/hooks/fleet.conf`: `PYTHON_VERSION=3.14`, `FRONTEND_DIRS="frontend"`, `APT_PACKAGES="libimage-exiftool-perl libfaketime"`. `.claude/settings.json`: SessionStart → `$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.claude/hooks/fleet-session-start.sh`; `"extraKnownMarketplaces": {"fleet": {"source": {"source": "github", "repo": "AnthonyPluth/fleet", "ref": "v1.x.y"}}}`; no `enabledPlugins` entry: cloud sessions don't install plugins a repository declares, so agents get the vendored copies, and enabling the plugin as well would load each skill twice in a local session.
- `[tool.fleet]` in `pyproject.toml`: migrations `darkroom/storage/migrations/versions`, migration tests `tests/test_migrations.py`, tested-from `0001`, image homes `darkroom/static/`, `docs/design/` (signed-off designs, #16 and #34), `ios/Darkroom/Assets.xcassets/`, skills `.claude/skills`, no-comments over `darkroom`, `darkroom_browser`, `tests`, `tools` and `frontend/src`, coverage floors as in the Makefile bullet, `extra-checks = "tools.app_checks:CHECKS"`.
- `AGENTS.md`: fleet's blocks for "Starting work", "Working in a container", "Mistakes that keep coming back" (it opens with the rule that a mistake that repeats gets a lint, Semgrep, type or test check and that the item names the check) and "Git and PRs", between `<!-- fleet:begin … -->` and `<!-- fleet:end … -->` markers; Darkroom's own text (layout, commands, conventions, the promises, its own mistakes after the block) outside them. Darkroom's first own mistake item: "Deletion safety (checked: Semgrep `darkroom-confirmed-flag-single-writer` from #24 and `darkroom-eligibility-single-path` from #37; `tests/test_eligibility_invariants.py`)". If this issue has an **AGENTS.md outline** section, its headings of the same names are filled by the fleet blocks and its Darkroom-specific bullets follow each block.
- The agent review, merge gate, security scans and fleet sync callers, `CODEOWNERS` and the ruleset are {{P2-09}} (Fable), which merges right after this issue and before wave 2.

append_section:
**Required iOS check**
Agents can't run Xcode, so the `iOS` workflow is their compile feedback and a required merge-gate check, not an option.
- `.github/workflows/ios.yml`, workflow name `iOS`, on pull requests and pushes to `main`: a `changes` job (ubuntu) for `ios/**` and the workflow file, and a `build` job on a pinned macOS image (`macos-15`, not `-latest`, so Xcode doesn't change under a PR) that runs only when `ios/` changed: select the Xcode version in `ios/.xcode-version`, install XcodeGen at a pinned version, `xcodegen generate`, `swift test --package-path ios/Packages/DarkroomCore`, then `xcodebuild -project ios/Darkroom.xcodeproj -scheme Darkroom -destination 'generic/platform=iOS Simulator' -derivedDataPath build CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO build` (no team id, certificate or secret), piped through `xcbeautify --renderer github-actions` so compile errors become file:line annotations an agent reads from the PR's checks; the `.xcresult` uploaded on failure; `contents: read`; SwiftPM and DerivedData cached on `ios/` lockfile hashes.
- A PR that doesn't touch `ios/` skips the build job, and a skipped job counts as passed, so backend PRs never wait on macOS.
- In this PR, add `iOS` to `required-workflows` and to the `workflow_run` list in `.github/workflows/merge-gate.yml` ({{P2-09}}'s caller). Adding it earlier would hold every PR waiting for a workflow that doesn't exist.
- Cost: Darkroom is private, so macOS minutes count ten times against the account's included minutes. Note a cold and a cached run's duration in the PR and in `ios/README.md`.
- The owner's Mac and device checks stay: signing, PhotoKit, background tasks and notifications can't run in CI.
- The iOS agent brief in `docs/HANDOFF.md` gains: "read the `iOS` check's annotations; a red `iOS` check blocks the merge".
